meta.title: Mulank 8 ka Game — 2027 warm-up reel
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count
meta.look: 2D sci-fi sitcom toon (Lemo-Opuscar "PLUS" theme): thick dark ink outlines, flat fills with one soft shade, warm rim light. Night city rooftop with Diwali lights; cosmic office in clouds; dark blue court with Saturn.
meta.audio_target: -14 LUFS, true peak about -2 dBTP; music ducked under voice

beats.picture: Close-up of an old Diwali sutli bomb painted "2026". Fuse sparks big, then fizzles out. Hook banner from frame 0: "MULANK 8 WALO, SUNO!" / "born on 8 • 17 • 26".
beats.camera: Tight close-up on the bomb, tiny shake.

beats.line: Ab tu gaya beta! Mulank 8 hai na tu?
beats.picture: Vishnu ji on a red plastic chair on a city rooftop at night, chai kulhad in hand, grins.
beats.camera: Whip pan, then crash zoom onto his grin.
beats.sound: Bass drop + sting on "Ab tu gaya beta".

beats.line: Aayein?!
beats.picture: Monty: small dip (anticipation), then eyes pop, hair spikes, both arms fly up.

beats.line: Arre, teri incognito history seedha Shani dev tak pahunch gayi! "7 din mein ameer kaise bane" tak! 2027 mein Mulank 8 ki class Shani dev lenge!

caption_chunks.text: seedha Shani dev tak pahunch gayi!
"7 din mein ameer kaise bane" tak!

beats.picture: Speed lines. A phone shows the incognito icon; Vishnu ji motor-mouths with hand gestures; cut to Monty caught.
beats.sound: Ding on the "ameer kaise bane" search gag.

beats.line: Tu 17, Bunty 8, Khanna sir 26… teeno Mulank 8!
beats.picture: MULANK INTRO: three cards pop one by one, ~1 s each, each big with name + date sum — "TU — MONTY 17 MAR → 1+7 = 8", "COUSIN BUNTY 8 AUG → 8", "BOSS — KHANNA SIR 26 JUL → 2+6 = 8". Then they park in a row and their 8 coins merge into one big gold 8.
beats.camera: Static wide behind dimmed terrace; cards are graphics on top.
beats.sound: Tick + boing on each card; ding + bass when the coins merge.

beats.line: Boss bhi?!
beats.picture: Monty crash zoom with an evil grin; the boss card gets a sweat drop.

beats.line: Ruko zara, sabar karo... proof kahan hai?
beats.delivery: Fake-calm meme delivery ("Ruko zara, sabar karo"), then suspicious.
beats.picture: Monty puts a palm up: stop.

beats.line: Proof? Arre chal chal, head office, abhi ke abhi!
beats.picture: Vishnu ji flicks and fidget-spins the chakra.
Chakra swirl wipe (iris grows from the centre) into the cosmic head office.

beats.line: Ek-ek karke aao! Chaar haath hain, chaar sau nahi!

caption_chunks.text: Chaar haath hain, chaar sau nahi!

beats.delivery: Busy office clerk, a bit fed up.
beats.picture: Brahma ji (four arms) behind a token counter in the clouds, stamping files with two hands in rhythm.
beats.camera: Camera slides down from the sky onto the counter.

beats.line: Aath? Seedha Shani dev ke paas. Next!

caption_chunks.text: Aath? Seedha Shani dev ke paas.

beats.picture: A slip flies onto Monty's forehead: "8 = SHANI DEV".
Lights cut to black; Shani dev's court fades up, halo glow first.
beats.sound: Thunder; music stops; clock ticks start.

beats.line: Mulank aath… haazri.
beats.picture: Shani dev: lifts the trishul and thumps it down on "haazri". Stern only here; eyes on his register, then on Monty — never the lens.
beats.sound: Trishul thump + sub on "haazri", hall reverb.

beats.line: P-p-p-present sir!
beats.picture: Monty's fear: hands clasped at his chin, knees buckle and shake on planted feet, shiver through neck and shoulders, sweat drop.

beats.line: Resolution mein kaun tha? Diet… Monday se. Savings… zero. Neend… teen baje.
beats.delivery: Calm, dry, each item a verdict. Meme format: triple crash zoom.
beats.picture: Three crash zooms with tags: DIET: MONDAY SE / SAVINGS: 0 / NEEND: 3 AM.

beats.line: Gym ki yaad nahi aayi tujhe, Monty?

caption_chunks.text: Gym ki yaad nahi aayi tujhe, Monty?

beats.picture: Shani dev turns his gaze to Monty (side-on, never the lens).

beats.line: Prabhu… main toh aapka bada fan hoon…
beats.picture: Monty: folded hands, nervous smile.

beats.line: Baccha hai tu mera.
beats.picture: Shani dev half-nods; the crow tilts its head.

beats.line: Koi shortcut?
beats.picture: Monty leans in hopefully.
The crow on Shani dev's shoulder: "KAA!" (beak opens).

beats.line: Ye kehta hai… nahi.
beats.picture: Back to Shani dev, deadpan.

beats.line: Main saza nahi deta. Hisaab deta hoon. Mehnat karo… result main dunga.
beats.delivery: Most dignified line: slow, warm authority. Lift on "Hisaab".
beats.picture: Halo glows warm gold and brightens on "Hisaab"; he lifts the KARMA register high.
beats.sound: Warm swell under the voice; sub on "Hisaab".

beats.picture: Swirl wipe back to the rooftop.

beats.line: Ye dukh kaahe khatam nahi hota...
beats.picture: A small rain cloud over only Monty; tears; he slumps.
Sakshi walks in (two side-steps), sparkles; tag "TOPPER ENTRY".

beats.line: Notes chahiye?
beats.picture: Sakshi fans her tarot cards, one brow up.

beats.line: Main kuch nahi bola.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji hides behind his kulhad, eyes darting.

beats.line: Syllabus sabka alag. Date + month + 2. Single digit. Wahi tera 2027.
beats.picture: Formula builds on screen: DATE + MONTH + 2; example "17 Mar → 1+7+3+2 = 13 → 4". Monty counts on his fingers.

beats.line: Mera 4! ...accha hai na?
beats.picture: Monty fists up, a big "4" pops; then scratches his head, sweat.

beats.line: 4 = mehnat aur neev ka saal, shortcut nahi. Baaki numbers ka plan? Comment karo REPORT
beats.delivery: Reassuring, then CTA clearly: "Comment karo REPORT".
beats.picture: Bricks stack on the floor (neev = foundation). Comment box types REPORT and holds ~3.5 s. Sakshi winks.
beats.sound: Brick thumps, typing keys, send ding.

beats.picture: The old bomb finally explodes; Monty gets an afro; Vishnu ji keeps sipping.

beats.line: Der hai… andher nahi.
beats.picture: Shani dev in a big round sky portal with a gold rim; the rooftop dims behind.

beats.line: Ab tu gaya beta.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji sips, same framing as the opening.
Bomb close-up again, new fuse sparks; hook banner + "Comment REPORT" end card (2.6 s). Loops to frame 0.
